item.title: Patrick Stewart, ‘Star Trek’ Captain Picard and ‘X-Men’ actor, dies at 86
item.description: Stewart died in Los Angeles after living with Alzheimer's disease and Lewy body dementia.

item.title: Trump administration attempts to take down leak of ICE personnel data
item.description: An Icelandic web company, FlokiNET, has defended the data's publication as satisfying a 'legitimate' public interest.

item.title: Palestinians face growing bans from Al-Aqsa as Israel tightens control
item.description: As Israel renews a ban on Al-Aqsa imam, Islamic Waqf officials warn of shrinking authority at Muslim holy site.

item.title: Israel bans travel for Brad Lander after detention in occupied West Bank
item.description: Israel has revoked travel authorisation for US Democratic congressional candidate Brad Lander after he was detained.

item.title: Real Madrid and FC Barcelona honour Spain train crash victims
item.description: Spanish football clubs were among those to hold a minute’s silence for the victims of Wednesday’s train collision.

item.title: Palestinians injured, arrested in Israeli raids across West Bank
item.description: This comes as more than 3,300 Palestinians are forced from homes in Hebron as Israel's military offensive continues.

item.title: Does Russia offer African countries an equal partnership?
item.description: President Vladimir Putin hosts African leaders at a summit in Moscow.

item.title: Israel election result shows no overall majority as vote count complete
item.description: Opposition explores options to form coalition as no party secures the 61 seats required for parliamentary majority.

item.title: Man targeted Muslims, Africans and North Africans, French prosecutors say
item.description: Prosecutor Olivier Christen said suspect admitted that he chose the location because it was 'a hotbed for Islamists'.

item.title: Cornell begins no confidence vote over handling of alleged gang rape
item.description: Faculty vote will continue until next Friday and could send message that school's president has lost their confidence.

item.title: Trump says won’t ‘take sides’ in Brazil election, but calls it a ‘disgrace’
item.description: Comments come after Trump ally Flavio Bolsonaro fled to Miami in US and claimed, without evidence, that vote was stolen.

item.title: Netanyahu attacks Palestinian-Israeli parties as he falls short of majority
item.description: With all votes now counted, opposition parties could join forces with Palestinian-Israeli parties to unseat Netanyahu.

item.title: ‘Arab voice doesn’t count’: Jewish Israeli blocs reject Palestinian support
item.description: Palestinian voters could decide Israel’s future, but its political class refuses to accept their mandate

item.title: Pentagon fires general it says leaked classified information to media
item.description: Army Lieutenant General Brett Sylvia was subject of investigation into leaking information about Iran and Ukraine.

item.title: Texas Republican group seeks to block certification of state’s election
item.description: Republicans in a Texas county have filed a lawsuit asking for ballots in the state's midterm races to be hand-counted.

item.title: US Muslims concerned but resilient as ‘hate’ attacks target Abdul El-Sayed
item.description: Muslim advocates say the best way to respond to hate is to elect the Democratic candidate in Michigan to US Senate.

item.title: Finland launches criminal probe of suspected environmental damage by Google
item.description: The US tech giant is investing $15bn in a huge new data centre project in northern Finland.

item.title: Al Jazeera marks 30th anniversary with network overhaul
item.description: Marking three decades, Al Jazeera unveils a new structure: three channels, 33 programmes, and tech-driven innovation.

item.title: Albanian opposition storms parliament, sets off flares and smoke bombs
item.description: Opposition lawmakers disrupt parliament session, accusing prime minister of downplaying ongoing antigovernment protests.

item.title: At least 14 people killed in attack on Ukraine train station
item.description: A Russian drone strike killed at least 14 people at Dnipro’s main railway station in central Ukraine.

item.title: Pakistan rights activist Imaan Mazari and husband jailed for 10 years
item.description: Couple say they are 'prisoners of conscience' being made an example of by Pakistan's military-backed authorities.

item.title: UAE sentences eight people to life over arms supplies to Sudan’s army
item.description: Defendants handed ⁠life sentences amid tensions between Khartoum and Abu Dhabi over Sudan's war and the RSF.

item.title: France football chief backs Real Madrid’s Mbappe after China apology
item.description: Real Madrid's Kylian Mbappe should be allowed to move on after apology to China, says French football federation chief.

item.title: European Central Bank President Lagarde to step down early
item.description: Christine Lagarde will leave the post in February, nine months before the end of her eight-year term.

item.title: Why US Sports Owners Spend Millions on Politics
item.description: US sports team owners include some of the wealthiest people in the world and some spend millions of dollars on politics
